text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy gets injured during<n>training, so I rush
her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gyaaahhh! It hurts real bad!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nghhh! But I don't have time to sit<n>around
recoverin'!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's gonna leave me behind...<n>And I won't
have a chance of<n>winnin' anymore!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I... I don't want that to happen!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Please! Let me get back to runnin'!
choice_data_list: You need to focus on recovery for now.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrr! You're such a blockhead!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Patience, huh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I guess I'll listen to your<n>advice. But just
this once!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And in exchange, you gotta do<n>whatever I say!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
First, go buy some apples! Then I<n>want ya to cut
'em up into nice little<n>bunnies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I acquiesce to all of Shinko Windy's<n>demands, and
she thankfully rests<n>like I want her to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that in exchange, I absolutely<n>don't want
her pushing herself.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! So I can run as long as I<n>don't overdo it.
Right! No take backs!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Now let's head back to the track!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ow, owwwiiieee! It's throbbin' real<n>bad!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Fine, but only for today! I'll be all<n>healed up by
tomorrow for sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I somehow calm the flustered Shinko<n>Windy and
convince her to take it<n>easy for a while as she
recovers.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. I feel great!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whaddya think?! No problems, right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wicked! Then I'mma keep running<n>like this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy continues her training<n>without
overdoing it, and she's able<n>to overcome her
injury.
